method: Second, independent pass (x2_*): own shooting/bisection hedgehog with analytic tails (+ pion-mass family), direct 3D finite-difference evaluation of the hedgehog-Hopf energy and radii, Demidov-Levkov quadrature plus tick-mark-calibrated pixel digitisation of arXiv:1103.0013 Fig. 3b and 1103.2133 Fig. 7b, all derived numbers via different routes (MeV-level rotor, root-found floors, SI vacuum energy). The first-pass cross-check (cc_*, Ritz-spectral hedgehog, hopfion identity) was re-run from scratch and reproduced its numbers exactly; its results are kept as cc_crosscheck.json.

issues.description: Demidov-Levkov two-particle exponent at high energy is misread: E7 hard-codes F = 3.93 (e7_audit.py, 'F2 = 3.93', an eye reading of arXiv:1103.0013 Fig. 3b) with a stated +-0.05 reading uncertainty. Pixel digitisation with the axes calibrated on the tick marks (4.4/4.2/4.0 ticks at 111 px spacing at 600 dpi; x ticks 7..11 at 166.5 px) gives a plateau F = 3.845 for g^2E >= 10.5 (3.845 at g^2E = 11.5); the panel's left edge reads g^2E = 6.240 = 2 g^2 M_S, which validates the calibration. Two independent digitisations (first pass 3.846, this pass 3.845) agree. The error (-0.085) is outside the stated tolerance and propagates into six more headline numbers: kappa 0.63 -> 0.62, g^2 for P = 0.1/1/e/0.5 = 1.71/3.93/5.67 -> 1.67/3.84/5.55, M_S/m at P = 0.1: 1.83 -> 1.87, and the illustrative 10^-234 -> 10^-229. No conclusion or seed verdict changes.
issues.suggested_fix: Use F = 3.85 (plateau) and 4.48 (threshold) in e7_audit.py, results.json, fig_vacuum_pairs.png, REPORT.md and the summary; state the reading uncertainty as about +-0.01 for a tick-calibrated digitisation.

issues.description: Hopfion energy-rms radius is wrong: R_rms = 2.144 (Ward units) should be 2.0608. Cause (found in e7_hopfion.py after the comparison): the profile is a 24-node not-a-knot cubic spline in t = r/(1+r) with f(t=1) = 0 but free slope, so f ~ a/r at large r; then int r^2 eps d^3r diverges linearly and is cut off by the last Gauss node. My direct 3D evaluation with the exact optimal profile f(r) = F_Skyrme(sqrt2 r) gives 2.060816 at four resolutions and two radial maps; adding an a/r tail with a = 2e-3 moves R_rms to 2.10-2.13 (map dependent) while E_W changes by < 1e-6, which reproduces the mechanism. Consequences: hopfion c0 = 341 to 567 (not 590), electron g^2 = 1/kappa4 >= 1.2e9 to 2.0e9 (not 2.1e9), sqrt(kappa2) = 82.9 MeV (not 84.5). Energy and ring radius are unaffected. No conclusion changes.
issues.suggested_fix: Impose f ~ C/r^2 in the spline (e.g. fit f(t)/(1-t)^2) or use f(r) = F_Skyrme(sqrt2 r); report R_rms = 2.061, c0 = 341-567, g^2 >= 1.2-2.0e9.

issues.description: Hopfion 'CALIBRATED' is not an independent calibration: for the hedgehog-Hopf ansatz the angle-averaged Faddeev-Skyrme energy of f(r) is exactly (1/(3 pi^2)) x the ANW hedgehog functional of F(x) = f(x/sqrt2), so E_W(ansatz) = a1/(3 pi^2) = 1.2314457 identically (confirmed by my 3D quadrature to 2e-8). The '<= 5% above 1.204' tolerance was set by the original agent; PLAN has no E7 hopfion target, and E8's preregistered 2% would not pass (2.3%).
issues.suggested_fix: Label it 'variational upper bound, consistent with 1.204-1.22' (no CALIBRATED).

issues.description: Proton M R/hbar c labelled CALIBRATED against PLAN's '~2.8', which is a PLAN expectation, not a literature target, with a tolerance (+-0.05) chosen by the original agent. PLAN's own formula c0/e^2 gives 2.598, outside that band; the pass relies on M_N = 939 MeV x classical radius (2.826). The model radius is the isoscalar radius, while the data value 3.998 uses the proton charge radius (which diverges in the massless-pion Skyrme model), so the comparison is indicative only.
issues.suggested_fix: Report 2.60 (classical) and 2.83 (M_N) as CONFIRMED for PLAN's expectation 'classical fold, ~2.8', not CALIBRATED.

issues.description: The QED illustration 'a fold-like exp(-F/alpha) factor would be about 10^-234' depends on identifying DL's g^2 with alpha. With the loop-counting coupling of QED in the same normalisation, g^2 = e^2 = 4 pi alpha, it is 10^-18.6 (10^-18.2 with F = 3.85). e7_audit.py computes both and the figure marks 4 pi alpha, but the report and summary quote only 10^-234. The qualitative point (QED pair production is perturbative, not fold-like) holds either way.
issues.suggested_fix: Quote both identifications (10^-229 for g^2 = alpha, 10^-18 for g^2 = 4 pi alpha), or only the 4 pi alpha one.

issues.description: Pairs: the PLAN-specified combination with E1e can now be made (E1 finished after E7 ran). E1's smallest classical producer reproduced at dx = 0.05 has N_lin lambda/m^2 = 1.688, i.e. g^2 N_min(phi^4) <= 3.38 = 2.53 N_pair (g^2 = 2 lambda/m^2); N = 2 quanta needs g^2 >= 1.69 (lambda/m^2 >= 0.84). This corroborates the DL-based estimate (P = 0.1 at g^2 = 1.67). Separately, 'unsuppressed for g^2 >~ 1.7-5.7' extrapolates the leading semiclassical exponent exp(-F/g^2) to g^2 = O(1), where prefactors and higher orders are uncontrolled; indicative only.
issues.suggested_fix: Add the E1e numbers to the Pairs section and drop deviation 1 or mark it superseded; call the thresholds indicative.

issues.description: Small inconsistencies: (a) the floor for E_rot <= 0.1 M is 2.3947, printed 2.40 in the results.json note and 2.39 in the report; (b) lambda_C/R and the vacuum ratios are QUANTIFIED in results.json but NO_TARGET in the summary; (c) 'c0 stays >= 52 with any pion mass' holds for the baryon-rms radius only: with the half-baryon radius c0 falls to 47.3 at beta = 16 (c0_half_min in results.json, not mentioned in the report); (d) the floor 0.757 is for the baryon-rms radius (0.627 with the half-baryon radius).
issues.suggested_fix: Harmonise rounding and labels; state the radius definition with each floor and pion-mass number.

issues.description: The LEP bound r_e < 1.1e-19 m (Schael et al. 2013, Eq. 3.9) is model dependent: it is the VV contact-interaction scale with positive interference and electromagnetic coupling strength converted to a size. The report quotes it without this qualifier.
issues.suggested_fix: Add the qualifier where the bound is introduced.

issues.description: Unlisted deviation: PLAN says 'compute c0 from the E2 profile'; E7 solved its own hedgehog. It agrees with E2's profile.json (a1 = 36.46164562524, Lambda = 50.97873911, C = 8.6385782) to <= 1e-9, so the effect is nil.

Generalisation wording: the scaling statement M R = c0/(g^2 hbar) is a theorem for theories with one length and one overall coupling; with extra dimensionless parameters c0 can move, and only the pion-mass family and the hopfion were tested. What is fully general is the semiclassical criterion (action per light-crossing ~ M R c >> hbar, i.e. R >> lambda_C); the corollary 'needs g^2 >> 1' requires c0 >~ O(1). The report's General statement says this, but the seed-claim text ('this holds for any soliton with action S0/g^2') is broader.
issues.suggested_fix: Qualify the seed-claim sentence: 'for any one-scale soliton family; two-parameter families tested (pion mass, hopfion) keep c0 >= 47'.
